objects.description: This header defines only macros and includes; it introduces no structs, classes, enums, or typedef-defined types. Therefore, there are no custom data types to document.

Sentinel type representing an empty/none value used by OneFlow's maybe utilities. It is intended to serve both as a null option (like std::nullopt) and as a monostate marker for variant-like constructs. Instances compare equal and have a fixed hash. Used via the constexpr instance oneflow::maybe::NullOpt.
Tag type indicating in-place construction for maybe/optional/variant-like containers. Used via the constexpr instance oneflow::maybe::InPlace.
Sentinel incomplete type used to signal that a type lookup failed (e.g., out-of-range access in TypeGetS). It is only forward-declared here and intentionally incomplete.
Internal helper providing O(N) or O(log N) visitation dispatch over Variant based on number of alternatives. Not part of public API; used as a friend of Variant.
Tag type used to signal that visit() should auto-deduce the common result type from the visitor over all active alternatives.
Friend/utility scope exposing internal accessors and combinators for Optional, used by JUST/Map/Bind/OrElse implementations. Not intended for public construction or storage.

Referenced as a friend of Optional to allow macro JUST access to Value(). It is not defined in this header; declared elsewhere. Since it is only referenced here and not defined, leaving definition empty per instructions.
Specialization that formats a message by prefixing the code and concatenating arguments into a single std::string when any args are provided; otherwise returns the code as string.
Specialization that leaves a std::string_view message unchanged; only accepts a single code argument.

Internal helper struct providing static functions used by JUST/CHECK_JUST macros. It calls Value() on Maybe/Optional-like objects and obtains/creates a stacked error either from Maybe::StackedError() or via JustTraits for non-Maybe types. Not intended for public construction or ownership; purely a function namespace.
Tag type used to in-place-construct the Ok/value state of a Maybe-like object. The constant Ok is the canonical instance used at call sites.
Tag type used to in-place-construct the Error state of a Maybe-like object. The constant InPlaceError is the canonical instance used at call sites.
Friend helper providing internal access to Maybe's protected members and defining Map/Bind algorithms that operate on Maybe-like objects while propagating stacked errors.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::NullOptType::operator==
functions.description: Compares two NullOptType sentinel values for equality. Always returns true since all instances represent the same null/empty sentinel. Use to check equality between NullOptType values in comparisons or containers.
requirements: No special requirements; argument can be any oneflow::maybe::NullOptType value.
This operator does not throw and does not modify state.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::NullOptType::operator!=
functions.description: Compares two NullOptType sentinel values for inequality. Always returns false since all instances are equivalent. Useful for generic code requiring an inequality operator.
requirements: No special requirements; argument can be any oneflow::maybe::NullOptType value.
This operator does not throw and does not modify state.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::NullOptType::operator<
functions.description: Less-than comparison for NullOptType. Always returns false to define a total but degenerate ordering where no value is less than another.
requirements: No special requirements; argument can be any oneflow::maybe::NullOptType value.
This operator does not throw and does not modify state.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::NullOptType::operator>
functions.description: Greater-than comparison for NullOptType. Always returns false, consistent with all instances being equivalent.
requirements: No special requirements; argument can be any oneflow::maybe::NullOptType value.
This operator does not throw and does not modify state.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::NullOptType::operator<=
functions.description: Less-than-or-equal comparison for NullOptType. Always returns true, establishing a consistent ordering even though all instances are equivalent.
requirements: No special requirements; argument can be any oneflow::maybe::NullOptType value.
This operator does not throw and does not modify state.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::NullOptType::operator>=
functions.description: Greater-than-or-equal comparison for NullOptType. Always returns true, consistent with all instances being equivalent.
requirements: No special requirements; argument can be any oneflow::maybe::NullOptType value.
This operator does not throw and does not modify state.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::HashCombine
functions.signature:
template <class T>
constexpr void oneflow::maybe::HashCombine(std::size_t& seed, const T& v)
functions.description: Combines the existing hash seed with the hash of value v using a standard mixing formula. Intended for building composite hashes (e.g., hashing multiple fields of a struct) by repeatedly calling with the same seed.
requirements: Template parameter T must be hashable: std::hash<T> must be well-formed and callable.
The seed parameter must reference a valid std::size_t that the function can modify.
The function requires #include <functional> for std::hash (already included in this header).
The operation is constexpr-capable; arguments must be usable in a constexpr context if constexpr evaluation is desired.

functions.name: std::hash<oneflow::maybe::NullOptType>::operator()
functions.description: Returns a fixed hash value for NullOptType instances, allowing NullOptType to be used as a key or component in hashed containers. Always returns oneflow::maybe::NullOptHash.
requirements: No special requirements; accepts any oneflow::maybe::NullOptType value.
Guaranteed not to throw (noexcept).

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Variant::Variant
functions.signature:
template <typename... Ts, typename T = typename oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>::template TypeByIndex<0>, std::enable_if_t<std::is_default_constructible<T>::value, int> = 0>
oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>::Variant()
functions.description: Default-constructs the variant, initializing it with the first alternative type (TypeByIndex<0>). Only participates in overload resolution if that first type is default-constructible. Use to create a Variant holding its first type's default value.
requirements: The class template parameter pack Ts... must contain at least two distinct, non-reference, non-cv-qualified types (enforced by static_asserts on the class).
The first alternative type (TypeByIndex<0>) must be default-constructible.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Variant::Visit
functions.signature:
template <typename... Ts, typename R = oneflow::maybe::details::AutoDeducedResultType, typename F>
decltype(auto) oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>::Visit(F&& f) &
functions.description: Visits the currently held value with a callable f and returns its result. This overload is for lvalue variants (&). If R is AutoDeducedResultType, the return type is deduced as the common_type of all possible f(Ts&) results.
requirements: The callable F must be invocable with Ts& for every alternative that might be held at runtime; at minimum it must be invocable with the currently held type.
If R is AutoDeducedResultType (default), the results of F(Ts&) for all Ts... must share a common_type.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Variant::operator=
functions.signature:
template <typename... Ts, typename T, std::enable_if_t<oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>::template HasType<oneflow::maybe::RemoveCVRef<T>>, int> = 0>
oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>& oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>::operator=(T&& value)
functions.description: Assigns the variant to hold the exact alternative matching RemoveCVRef<T>, constructing it from the given argument. If the variant already holds T, it assigns a new T(value); otherwise it destroys the current value and constructs T in-place.
requirements: RemoveCVRef<T> must be exactly one of Ts....
T must be constructible from the provided argument.
If the variant already holds T, T must be copy/move-assignable from the provided argument; otherwise, T must be constructible from it.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Variant::Index
functions.description: Returns the index (0-based) of the currently held alternative.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Variant::Is
functions.signature:
template <typename... Ts, typename T, std::enable_if_t<oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>::template HasType<T>, int> = 0>
bool oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>::Is() const
functions.description: Checks whether the variant currently holds the specified alternative T.
requirements: T must be exactly one of Ts....

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Variant::~Variant
functions.description: Destroys the currently held value and the variant itself. Calls the destructor of the active alternative.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Variant::operator==
functions.signature:
template <typename... Ts>
bool oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>::operator==(const oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>& other) const
functions.description: Compares two variants for equality. If they hold different alternatives (indices differ), returns false. Otherwise, compares the held values with operator== of that alternative.
requirements: The held alternative type must have a valid operator== for its own type.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Variant::operator!=
functions.signature:
template <typename... Ts>
bool oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>::operator!=(const oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>& other) const
functions.description: Returns the logical negation of operator==.
requirements: Same as operator==.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Variant::operator<
functions.signature:
template <typename... Ts>
bool oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>::operator<(const oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>& other) const
functions.description: Provides a strict-weak ordering between variants. If indices differ, compares indices. If indices are equal, compares the held values with operator< of that alternative.
requirements: The held alternative type must have a valid operator< for its own type.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Variant::operator>=
functions.signature:
template <typename... Ts>
bool oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>::operator>=(const oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>& other) const
functions.description: Returns !(operator<).
requirements: Same as operator<.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Variant::operator>
functions.signature:
template <typename... Ts>
bool oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>::operator>(const oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>& other) const
functions.description: If indices differ, compares indices (greater if this index is larger). If indices are equal, compares the held values with operator> of that alternative.
requirements: The held alternative type must have a valid operator> for its own type.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Variant::operator<=
functions.signature:
template <typename... Ts>
bool oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>::operator<=(const oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>& other) const
functions.description: Returns !(operator>).
requirements: Same as operator>.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Variant::Emplace
functions.signature:
template <typename... Ts, typename T, typename... Args>
T& oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>::Emplace(Args&&... args)
functions.description: Emplaces a new value of alternative T. If the variant already holds T, assigns a new temporary T constructed from args to the existing object. Otherwise, destroys the current value and constructs T in-place, returning a reference to it.
requirements: T must be exactly one of Ts....
T must be constructible from Args....
If the variant already holds T, T must be assignable from T constructed with Args....

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Variant::Get
functions.signature:
template <typename... Ts, typename T, std::enable_if_t<oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>::template HasType<T>, int> = 0>
T& oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>::Get() &
functions.description: Returns a mutable reference to the held value of type T. Asserts that the variant currently holds T.
requirements: T must be exactly one of Ts....
The variant must currently hold T; otherwise an assertion will fail and behavior is undefined if assertions are disabled.

functions.name: std::hash::operator()
functions.signature:
template <typename... Ts>
size_t std::hash<oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>>::operator()(const oneflow::maybe::Variant<Ts...>& v) const noexcept
functions.description: Computes a hash value for a oneflow::maybe::Variant by combining the hash of its index with the hash of the currently held value. Intended for use in unordered containers.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Optional::Optional
functions.description: Default-constructs an empty Optional (no contained value). Use when you want a disengaged optional that can be assigned/emplaced later.
requirements: None beyond T being a valid type. The contained value is disengaged after construction (HasValue() == false).

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Optional::operator=
functions.description: Assigns the disengaged state (clears the Optional).
requirements: After assignment, HasValue() == false. Any previously contained value (if any) is destroyed/reset.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Optional::Emplace
functions.description: Constructs or replaces the contained value in-place using the provided arguments. Engages the Optional.
requirements: Args... must form a valid construction of T (aggregate or direct initialization depending on T).
If T is const, Emplace destroys previous value (if any) and constructs anew; otherwise may assign over an existing value when already engaged.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Optional::HasValue
functions.description: Returns true if the Optional currently contains a value, false otherwise.
requirements: None.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Optional::operator bool
functions.description: Explicit conversion to bool indicating engagement state (same as HasValue()).
requirements: None. Use in boolean contexts; requires explicit cast due to explicit operator.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Optional::operator==
functions.description: Compares two Optionals for equality. Returns true if both are engaged and their contained values compare equal, or if both are disengaged.
requirements: If both are engaged, T must be equality-comparable with operator==(const T&, const T&).

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Optional::operator!=
functions.description: Inequality comparison, logically the negation of operator==.
requirements: If both are engaged, T must be equality-comparable with operator==(const T&, const T&).

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Optional::operator<
functions.description: Strict-weak-order comparison. An engaged Optional compares less than another engaged Optional if its value is less; a disengaged Optional compares less than an engaged Optional; two disengaged Optionals are not less than each other.
requirements: If both are engaged, T must be less-than comparable with operator<(const T&, const T&).

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Optional::operator>=
functions.description: Greater-than-or-equal comparison, defined as the negation of operator<.
requirements: If both are engaged and operator< is used internally, T must be less-than comparable.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Optional::operator>
functions.description: Strict-weak-order comparison. An engaged Optional is greater than a disengaged Optional; between two engaged Optionals, compares their contained values.
requirements: If both are engaged, T must be greater-than comparable via operator>(const T&, const T&) (or equivalently support < to satisfy logic).

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Optional::operator<=
functions.description: Less-than-or-equal comparison, defined as the negation of operator>.
requirements: If both are engaged and operator> is used internally, T must be comparable for ordering.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Optional::ValueOr
functions.description: Returns the contained value if engaged (by const reference), otherwise returns the provided default v.
requirements: If engaged, returns a reference to the contained value; caller must ensure the Optional outlives any reference usage.
No constraints on T beyond being usable in comparison/copy as returned reference.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Optional::Reset
functions.description: Disengages the Optional, destroying or clearing any contained value.
requirements: None. After call, HasValue() == false.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Optional::Map
functions.signature: template<typename F> auto oneflow::maybe::Optional<T>::Map(F&& f) const&
functions.description: If engaged, applies function f to the contained value and returns an Optional of the result; otherwise returns NullOpt. Uses const lvalue access.
requirements: f must be invocable with (const T&) and the result type must be constructible/movable into an Optional of the result.
f should be pure or side-effect-safe; it will not be called when the Optional is disengaged.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Optional::Bind
functions.signature: template<typename F> auto oneflow::maybe::Optional<T>::Bind(F&& f) const&
functions.description: Monadic bind/flatMap on a const lvalue Optional. If engaged, calls f(value) and returns its result; otherwise returns NullOpt. f must return an Optional-like type.
requirements: f must be invocable with (const T&) and must return an Optional<U> for some U (IsOptional<U> == true).
No call to f occurs when disengaged.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Optional::OrElse
functions.signature: template<typename F> auto oneflow::maybe::Optional<T>::OrElse(F&& f) const&
functions.description: Fallback for a const lvalue Optional. If disengaged, either calls f() for side-effects (when f returns void) and returns NullOpt, or returns f() as a replacement Optional-compatible value. If engaged, returns this Optional unchanged.
requirements: If f returns void, it must be invocable with no arguments and side-effects are allowed; the function returns NullOpt in this case.
If f returns a value convertible to Optional<T>-like, it must be invocable with no arguments and its return must be convertible to std::decay_t<Optional<T>>.

functions.name: std::hash<oneflow::maybe::Optional<T>>::operator()
functions.description: Computes a hash for an Optional. If engaged, hashes the contained value (or the address of the referred value for reference T); otherwise returns a fixed NullOpt hash value.
requirements: If T is not a reference type, std::hash<std::remove_cv_t<T>> must be defined for T.
If T is a reference type, hashing uses the address of the referred object via std::hash<const std::remove_reference_t<T>*>.

functions.name: std::hash<oneflow::maybe::Optional<T>>::hashImpl
functions.signature: template<typename U = T, std::enable_if_t<!std::is_reference<U>::value, int> = 0> static std::size_t std::hash<oneflow::maybe::Optional<T>>::hashImpl(const T& v)
functions.description: Helper for hashing non-reference T: forwards to std::hash<std::remove_cv_t<T>>(v).
requirements: Enabled only when T is not a reference type.
std::hash<std::remove_cv_t<T>> specialization must be available for T.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::details::ErrorStackFromContainerBase<D>::StackSize
functions.description: Returns the number of entries currently stored in the error stack provided by the Derived type via GetStack(). Intended for querying stack depth in error reporting utilities.
requirements: D must provide GetStack() returning a container with size().
Safe to call at any time; container must be initialized.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::details::ErrorStackFromContainerBase<D>::PushStack
functions.description: Appends a new stack entry to the underlying stack container via emplace(end(), args...). Used to record a new frame/message in the error stack.
requirements: D must provide GetStack() returning a container with emplace(end(), ...) and end().
The forwarded arguments must form a valid constructor for the container's value_type (i.e., the stack entry type).
The underlying container must be in a valid state for insertion.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::details::ErrorStackFromContainerBase<D>::StackElem
functions.signature:
template<typename T = Derived>
const typename T::StackType::value_type& oneflow::maybe::details::ErrorStackFromContainerBase<D>::StackElem(std::size_t index) const
functions.description: Returns a const reference to the stack entry at the given index from the underlying stack container.
requirements: T (defaulting to Derived) must define StackType, and GetStack() must return a container indexable with operator[].
index must be less than StackSize() to avoid out-of-bounds access.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::details::ErrorStackFromContainerBase<D>::StackBegin
functions.description: Returns an iterator to the beginning of the underlying stack container (const).
requirements: D must provide GetStack() returning a container with begin().
The returned iterator is valid as long as the underlying container is not modified.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::details::ErrorStackFromContainerBase<D>::StackEnd
functions.description: Returns an iterator to the end of the underlying stack container (const).
requirements: D must provide GetStack() returning a container with end().
The returned iterator is valid as long as the underlying container is not modified.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::simple::MessageFormatTrait<std::string>::Format

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::simple::NoStackError<E>::NoStackError

requirements: E must not be a reference type (enforced by static_assert).
Moves/copies the provided error into internal storage; the argument must be compatible with ErrorType.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::simple::NoStackError<E>::Error
functions.description: Returns a mutable reference to the underlying error value.
requirements: Object must be a valid NoStackError instance.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::simple::NoStackError<E>::StackSize
functions.description: Always returns 0 since NoStackError does not track a stack.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::simple::NoStackError<E>::StackElem
functions.description: No-op accessor for a non-existent stack; provided for interface compatibility.
requirements: Callers should not rely on any returned value; this function does nothing.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::simple::NoStackError<E>::PushStack
functions.description: No-op method that ignores all arguments; provided for interface compatibility with stacked errors.
requirements: No specific requirements; arguments are ignored.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::simple::NoStackError<E>::Dump
functions.description: Returns a string containing only the error value followed by a newline.
requirements: ErrorType must be stream-insertable into std::ostream.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::simple::NoStackError<E>::Abort
functions.description: Prints the error to std::cerr and calls std::abort(). Does not return.
requirements: ErrorType must be stream-insertable into std::ostream.
Calling this function will terminate the process.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::details::JustPrivateScope::Value
functions.description: Returns the underlying value from a Maybe/Optional-like object by forwarding to v.Value(). Intended for internal use by JUST/CHECK_JUST helpers to uniformly extract the contained value.
requirements: v must be an object whose type provides a member function Value() returning the contained value.
T may be an lvalue or rvalue; the value category is perfectly forwarded.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::details::JustPrivateScope::StackedError
functions.signature:
template<typename T, std::enable_if_t<oneflow::maybe::IsMaybe<oneflow::maybe::RemoveCVRef<T>>::value, int> = 0>
static decltype(auto) oneflow::maybe::details::JustPrivateScope::StackedError(T&& v)
functions.description: Obtains the error object to be stack-augmented when a Maybe-like value check fails. For Maybe types, forwards to v.StackedError().
requirements: T must be a Maybe-like type (IsMaybe<RemoveCVRef<T>>::value == true).
The type of v must provide a member function StackedError() returning an error object compatible with StackedErrorTraits.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::details::RemoveRValConst
functions.signature:
template<typename T>
typename std::remove_const<typename std::remove_reference<T>::type>::type&& oneflow::maybe::details::RemoveRValConst(T&& v) noexcept
functions.description: Utility to strip const from an rvalue reference and return it as a non-const rvalue reference. Used to allow extracting values from temporary Maybe/Optional without keeping const qualification.
requirements: v must be passed as an rvalue (the function static_asserts that T&& is an rvalue reference).
Noexcept: the function is declared noexcept.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::details::JustPushStackAndReturn
functions.signature:
template<typename T, typename... Args>
decltype(auto) oneflow::maybe::details::JustPushStackAndReturn(T&& v, Args&&... args)
functions.description: Augments the error object v with stack/context information via StackedErrorTraits<RemoveCVRef<T>>::PushStack(...), then returns v. Used by JUST to return an error with added context.
requirements: There must be a StackedErrorTraits<RemoveCVRef<T>> specialization with a static function PushStack(T&&, Args&&...).
args must match the parameters expected by StackedErrorTraits::PushStack (typically file, line, function, and expression/message).
v is forwarded back to the caller after stack push; callers should use the returned value.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::details::JustPushStackAndAbort
functions.signature:
template<typename T, typename... Args>
[[noreturn]] void oneflow::maybe::details::JustPushStackAndAbort(T&& v, Args&&... args)
functions.description: Augments the error object v with stack/context information and then terminates the program via StackedErrorTraits<RemoveCVRef<T>>::Abort(v). Used by CHECK_JUST to report and abort on failure.
requirements: There must be a StackedErrorTraits<RemoveCVRef<T>> specialization with static functions PushStack(T&&, Args&&...) and Abort(T&&).
This function never returns (marked [[noreturn]]); callers must not expect control to continue after calling it.
args must supply appropriate stack/context data as expected by PushStack.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::details::JustGetValue
functions.signature:
template<typename T, std::enable_if_t<oneflow::maybe::IsMaybe<T>::value || oneflow::maybe::IsOptional<T>::value, int> = 0>
auto oneflow::maybe::details::JustGetValue(T&& v) -> oneflow::maybe::RemoveRValRef<decltype(oneflow::maybe::details::JustPrivateScope::Value(std::forward<T>(v)))>
functions.description: Extracts the contained value from a Maybe/Optional-like holder by calling JustPrivateScope::Value(v) and normalizing the return type with RemoveRValRef. Used internally by JUST/CHECK_JUST.
requirements: T must satisfy IsMaybe<T> == true or IsOptional<T> == true.
The underlying type's Value() must be valid and return the contained value.
Return type is adjusted by RemoveRValRef to prevent returning rvalue references to temporaries.

functions.name: JUST
functions.description: Macro that evaluates an expression producing a Maybe/Optional-like result, returns its value if present, or (on failure) returns from the current function with an error augmented with file/line/function and expression text. Internally calls details::JustGetValue, JustPrivateScope::StackedError, and JustPushStackAndReturn.
requirements: This is a macro, not a function; usable only when compiled with GCC/Clang or CUDA compilers supporting statement expressions.
The argument must produce a value that can be context-checked with operator! (truthiness of success) and from which value can be extracted via details::JustGetValue.
On failure path, the type used must support StackedErrorTraits and either v.StackedError() (for Maybe) or JustTraits<>::ValueNotFoundError(v) (for non-Maybe).
The surrounding function must be able to return the error object produced by JustPushStackAndReturn (i.e., compatible return type).

functions.name: CHECK_JUST
functions.description: Macro that evaluates an expression producing a Maybe/Optional-like result and either returns its value or, on failure, augments the error with context and aborts the program. Intended for enforcing invariants that must not continue on failure.
requirements: This is a macro, not a function; requires GCC/Clang/CUDA statement expressions.
The argument must yield a result with operator! and be compatible with details::JustGetValue for value extraction.
On failure, the error type must be compatible with StackedErrorTraits and either provide StackedError() (Maybe) or be supported by JustTraits<>::ValueNotFoundError(v).
Program will terminate on failure via StackedErrorTraits::Abort; callers must not rely on continued execution.

functions.name: JUST_MSG
functions.description: Macro variant of JUST that allows attaching extra formatted message arguments to the pushed stack information when a failure occurs. Returns the value on success; on failure, returns from the current function with an augmented error.
requirements: This is a macro; requires GCC/Clang/CUDA statement expressions.
_first argument_ must be an expression yielding a Maybe/Optional-like or supported custom holder; additional variadic arguments are forwarded as extra context to StackedErrorTraits::PushStack.
The surrounding function must be able to return the error object type.
Failure handling depends on the same StackedError/JustTraits requirements as JUST.

functions.name: CHECK_JUST_MSG
functions.description: Macro variant of CHECK_JUST that accepts additional message arguments for stack/context. Returns the value on success; on failure, augments error and aborts the program.
requirements: This is a macro; requires GCC/Clang/CUDA statement expressions.
_first argument_ must yield a Maybe/Optional-like or supported custom holder; variadic message arguments are forwarded to PushStack.
On failure, termination occurs via StackedErrorTraits::Abort; execution will not continue.
Depends on StackedError/JustTraits being available for the type.

functions.name: OPT_JUST
functions.description: Macro that evaluates a Maybe/Optional-like expression and returns its value on success; on failure, yields NullOpt instead of returning an error or aborting. Useful when propagating optional results.
requirements: This is a macro; requires GCC/Clang/CUDA statement expressions.
The argument must produce a result with operator! and be compatible with details::JustGetValue to extract the value.
On failure path it directly yields NullOpt; caller must be in a context where NullOpt is valid (e.g., returning Optional).

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::details::MaybePrivateScope::Value
functions.description: Internal helper that forwards to m.Value(). Intended to access the contained value of a Maybe-like object inside library internals. Returns whatever m.Value() returns, preserving value category.
requirements: T must provide a callable member function Value() that matches the expression std::forward<T>(m).Value().
m must be in a state where Value() is valid to call (typically the 'ok' state for Maybe-like types).
This is a pure forwarding utility; no error handling is performed here.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::details::MaybePrivateScope::StackedError
functions.description: Internal helper that forwards to m.StackedError(). Intended to access the stacked error object of a Maybe-like type inside library internals. Returns whatever m.StackedError() returns, preserving value category.
requirements: T must provide a callable member function StackedError() that matches the expression std::forward<T>(m).StackedError().
m must be in an error state where StackedError() is valid to call for the underlying type.
This is a pure forwarding utility; no error handling is performed here.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::details::MaybePrivateScope::Map
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename F>
static auto oneflow::maybe::details::MaybePrivateScope::Map(T&& maybe, F&& f)
    -> oneflow::maybe::Maybe<decltype(std::forward<F>(f)(std::forward<T>(maybe).Value())),
                             typename oneflow::maybe::RemoveCVRef<T>::StackedErrorType>
functions.description: Apply a transformation f to the successful value inside a Maybe-like object and wrap the result back into a Maybe with the same stacked error type. If maybe is an error, the error is propagated unchanged.
requirements: T must model a Maybe-like type: it must be contextually convertible to bool, and provide Value() and StackedError() members.
typename RemoveCVRef<T>::StackedErrorType must be defined and be a valid stacked error type for T.
F must be callable with the contained value: f(maybe.Value()) must be a valid expression.
If maybe evaluates to false (error), f is not called and the stacked error from maybe is returned.
f may return any type; the returned Maybe's value type is decltype(f(Value())).

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::details::MaybePrivateScope::Bind
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename F, typename U = std::decay_t<decltype(std::declval<F>()(std::declval<T>().Value()))>>
static auto oneflow::maybe::details::MaybePrivateScope::Bind(T&& maybe, F&& f)
    -> std::enable_if_t<oneflow::maybe::IsMaybe<U>::value, U>
functions.description: Monadic bind for Maybe-like objects. If maybe contains a value, calls f with that value and expects f to return another Maybe type, which is returned directly. If maybe is an error, the error is propagated unchanged.
requirements: T must model a Maybe-like type: it must be contextually convertible to bool, and provide Value() and StackedError() members.
F must be callable with the contained value: f(maybe.Value()) must be a valid expression.
decltype(f(maybe.Value())) (after std::decay_t) must be a Maybe type; otherwise this overload is disabled.
If maybe evaluates to false (error), f is not called and the stacked error from maybe is returned.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Maybe<T, E>::IsOk
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename E>
bool oneflow::maybe::Maybe<T, E>::IsOk() const
functions.description: Returns true if the Maybe contains a value (success) and false if it contains an error.
requirements: Callable on any Maybe<T,E> instance; no preconditions.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Maybe<T, E>::IsErr
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename E>
bool oneflow::maybe::Maybe<T, E>::IsErr() const
functions.description: Returns true if the Maybe contains an error and false if it contains a value.
requirements: Callable on any Maybe<T,E> instance; no preconditions.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Maybe<T, E>::operator bool
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename E>
explicit oneflow::maybe::Maybe<T, E>::operator bool() const
functions.description: Contextual conversion to bool. Returns true if the Maybe contains a value and false if it contains an error. Equivalent to IsOk().
requirements: Callable on any Maybe<T,E> instance; no preconditions.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Maybe<T, E>::GetStackedError
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename E>
decltype(auto) oneflow::maybe::Maybe<T, E>::GetStackedError() &
functions.description: Returns a reference to the stacked error object stored in the Maybe. Lvalue-qualified overload.
requirements: Must only be called when IsErr() is true; otherwise OF_MAYBE_ASSERT may fail.
Caller must handle the returned stacked error type E as defined by StackedErrorTraits<E>.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Maybe<T, E>::GetError
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename E>
decltype(auto) oneflow::maybe::Maybe<T, E>::GetError() &
functions.description: Returns a reference to the unstacked error object derived from the stacked error via StackedErrorTraits<E>::Error(). Lvalue-qualified overload.
requirements: Must only be called when IsErr() is true; otherwise OF_MAYBE_ASSERT may fail.
StackedErrorTraits<E> must provide Error(E&) returning the underlying error type.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Maybe<T, E>::Map
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename E, typename F>
auto oneflow::maybe::Maybe<T, E>::Map(F&& f) const &
functions.description: Transform the contained value using f and return a new Maybe with the transformed value and the same stacked error type. If this Maybe is an error, the error is propagated and f is not called. Lvalue-qualified overload.
requirements: This must be called on a Maybe<T,E> object; if IsErr() is true, f is not invoked.
F must be callable with a const ValueType& (or suitable reference as returned by Value()) and produce any type R; the return type is Maybe<R, E> where E is the stacked error type of this Maybe.

functions.name: oneflow::maybe::Maybe<T, E>::Bind
functions.signature:
template <typename T, typename E, typename F>
auto oneflow::maybe::Maybe<T, E>::Bind(F&& f) const &
functions.description: Monadic bind (flatMap). If this Maybe contains a value, calls f with the value and expects f to return another Maybe, which is returned. If this Maybe is an error, the error is propagated and f is not called. Const lvalue-qualified overload.
requirements: F must be callable with a const ValueType& (or suitable reference as returned by Value()) and return a Maybe-like type U for which IsMaybe<U>::value is true.
If this Maybe is an error (IsErr()), f is not called and the original error is propagated.

data_types.description: A free-form byte string carried in a std::string or std::string_view with no required structure or encoding. May contain any bytes, including NULs. Used where the API accepts generic text such as filenames, function names, codes, or messages without imposing a specific format.

generators.generator:
import random
import string
from typing import List

# This generator produces interesting arbitrary string data bytes suitable for
# FUZZ_PARAM_STR/FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME across stubs dealing with message
# formatting, filenames, function names, codes, etc. It aims to exercise:
# - printable ASCII, unicode-like UTF-8 sequences, and embedded NULs
# - path-like strings (absolute, relative, with dot segments)
# - function-like identifiers and mangled-looking names
# - long/short extremes and repeated patterns
# - numeric-looking strings
# - strings with stream-insertable punctuation
# The result is a single bytes blob; the harness will split/consume as needed.

MAX_TOTAL = 4096

def _rand_ascii(r: random.Random, n: int) -> str:
    chars = string.printable
    return ''.join(r.choice(chars) for _ in range(n))

def _rand_utf8(r: random.Random, n: int) -> bytes:
    # Build valid-ish UTF-8 bytes: mix ASCII and multibyte code points
    out = bytearray()
    while len(out) < n:
        t = r.random()
        if t < 0.6:
            out.append(r.randrange(0x20, 0x7F))
        elif t < 0.8:
            # 2-byte
            cp = r.randrange(0x80, 0x7FF)
            out += bytes([
                0xC0 | ((cp >> 6) & 0x1F),
                0x80 | (cp & 0x3F),
            ])
        elif t < 0.95:
            # 3-byte
            cp = r.randrange(0x800, 0xFFFF)
            if 0xD800 <= cp <= 0xDFFF:
                cp = 0x20AC  # avoid surrogate range, use Euro sign
            out += bytes([
                0xE0 | ((cp >> 12) & 0x0F),
                0x80 | ((cp >> 6) & 0x3F),
                0x80 | (cp & 0x3F),
            ])
        else:
            # 4-byte
            cp = r.randrange(0x10000, 0x10FFFF)
            out += bytes([
                0xF0 | ((cp >> 18) & 0x07),
                0x80 | ((cp >> 12) & 0x3F),
                0x80 | ((cp >> 6) & 0x3F),
                0x80 | (cp & 0x3F),
            ])
    return bytes(out[:n])

def _path_variants(r: random.Random) -> List[str]:
    # Produce path-like strings that may be used as filenames or identifiers
    seps = ['/', '\\']
    sep = r.choice(seps)
    parts = []
    count = r.randint(1, 6)
    for i in range(count):
        choice = r.randint(0, 6)
        if choice == 0:
            parts.append('.')
        elif choice == 1:
            parts.append('..')
        else:
            base = _rand_ascii(r, r.randint(1, 10)).strip()
            # sanitize separators in part
            base = ''.join(ch if ch not in seps else '_' for ch in base)
            if not base:
                base = 'x'
            parts.append(base)
    rel = sep.join(parts)
    abs_path = sep + rel if r.random() < 0.5 else rel
    # add some extensions
    exts = ['', '.txt', '.log', '.json', '.proto', '.cfg']
    tail = r.choice(exts)
    return [rel, abs_path + tail]

def _identifier(r: random.Random) -> str:
    first = r.choice(string.ascii_letters + '_')
    rest_len = r.randint(0, 20)
    rest_pool = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + '::_$'
    rest = ''.join(r.choice(rest_pool) for _ in range(rest_len))
    return first + rest

def _numeric_like(r: random.Random) -> str:
    which = r.randint(0, 3)
    if which == 0:
        return str(r.randint(-10**9, 10**9))
    if which == 1:
        return hex(r.getrandbits(64))
    if which == 2:
        return str(r.random() * r.uniform(-1e6, 1e6))
    return str(r.randrange(0, 100000))

def _punctuation(r: random.Random, n: int) -> str:
    punct = ' !"#$%&\'()*+,-./:;<=>?@[\\]^_`{|}~'
    return ''.join(r.choice(punct) for _ in range(n))

def _with_nuls(r: random.Random, base: bytes) -> bytes:
    if not base:
        return b"\x00"
    b = bytearray(base)
    # insert a few NULs at random positions
    for _ in range(r.randint(1, 3)):
        pos = r.randrange(0, len(b) + 1)
        b[pos:pos] = b"\x00"
    return bytes(b)

def _assemble_chunks(chunks: List[bytes]) -> bytes:
    total = b''
    for c in chunks:
        if len(total) + len(c) > MAX_TOTAL:
            break
        total += c
    return total

def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    r = random.Random(seed)

    chunks: List[bytes] = []

    # 1) Short ASCII tokens (could serve as codes, function names)
    for _ in range(r.randint(2, 5)):
        s = _identifier(r)
        chunks.append(s.encode('utf-8') + b"\n")

    # 2) Path-like strings
    for p in _path_variants(r):
        chunks.append(p.encode('utf-8') + b"\n")

    # 3) Message codes and formatted-like lines
    for _ in range(r.randint(2, 4)):
        code = _identifier(r)
        a = _numeric_like(r)
        b = _numeric_like(r)
        line = f"{code}: {a} {b}"
        chunks.append(line.encode('utf-8') + b"\n")

    # 4) Random printable block
    print_len = r.randint(10, 120)
    chunks.append(_rand_ascii(r, print_len).encode('utf-8') + b"\n")

    # 5) UTF-8 heavy block
    utf_len = r.randint(32, 256)
    chunks.append(_rand_utf8(r, utf_len) + b"\n")

    # 6) Punctuation-heavy line
    chunks.append(_punctuation(r, r.randint(10, 60)).encode('utf-8') + b"\n")

    # 7) Some very short and very long strings
    chunks.append(b"\n")
    long_len = r.randint(300, 900)
    long_body = _rand_ascii(r, long_len).encode('utf-8')
    if r.random() < 0.5:
        long_body = _with_nuls(r, long_body)
    chunks.append(long_body + b"\n")

    # 8) A few standalone numbers as strings
    for _ in range(r.randint(2, 5)):
        chunks.append((_numeric_like(r) + "\n").encode('utf-8'))

    # 9) Repeated pattern to test streaming concatenation
    token = _identifier(r)
    rep = (token + ' ') * r.randint(3, 20)
    chunks.append(rep.encode('utf-8') + b"\n")

    # 10) Potential function signature-like strings
    for _ in range(r.randint(1, 3)):
        ret = r.choice(['void', 'int', 'double', 'std::string', 'auto'])
        name = _identifier(r)
        argsn = r.randint(0, 4)
        args = []
        for i in range(argsn):
            t = r.choice(['int', 'const char*', 'double', 'std::string_view', 'size_t'])
            args.append(f"{t} a{i}")
        sig = f"{ret} {name}({', '.join(args)})"
        chunks.append(sig.encode('utf-8') + b"\n")

    # 11) Add a small binary-ish chunk with NULs to ensure string_view paths handle it
    bin_len = r.randint(8, 64)
    bin_chunk = bytearray(_rand_utf8(r, bin_len))
    for _ in range(r.randint(1, 4)):
        pos = r.randrange(0, len(bin_chunk))
        bin_chunk[pos] = 0
    chunks.append(bytes(bin_chunk) + b"\n")

    return _assemble_chunks(chunks)
